Name: Stardew Audio Device Refresh
Author: TheAnkulai
Description:
Stardew Audio Device Refresh is a small Windows-only SMAPI utility mod that helps Stardew Valley recover audio after changing the Windows output device while the game is running.

By default, Stardew Valley may keep playing audio through the device that was active when the game started. This mod reopens the game’s OpenAL audio device so it can use the current default Windows output device without restarting the game.

The mod supports both manual refresh with a hotkey and optional automatic refresh when Windows changes the default audio output device.

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download the mod archive.
3. Extract the archive.
4. Place the [icode]StardewAudioDeviceRefresh[/icode] folder into your Stardew Valley [icode]Mods[/icode] folder.
5. Make sure the mod folder contains:
  - manifest.json
  - StardewAudioDeviceRefresh.dll
  - NAudio.Core.dll
  - NAudio.Wasapi.dll
6. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

Optional:

Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to change the mod settings in-game.

[line]

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

- Refresh Stardew Valley’s audio output device without restarting the game.
- Manual refresh hotkey, set to [icode]F8[/icode] by default.
- Test sound hotkey, set to [icode]F9[/icode] by default.
- Optional automatic refresh when the Windows default output device changes.
- Configurable delay before automatic refresh.
- Optional test sound after refresh.
- Generic Mod Config Menu support.
- Works even without Generic Mod Config Menu by using [icode]config.json[/icode].

This mod does not add an in-game audio device selector. It refreshes the game’s OpenAL audio device so Stardew Valley can use the current default Windows output device.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Required:

- Stardew Valley 1.6.x
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Windows

Optional:

- Generic Mod Config Menu

Included in the mod archive:

- NAudio.Core.dll
- NAudio.Wasapi.dll

Important:

Automatic refresh is Windows-only because it uses Windows audio device change notifications through NAudio / Windows CoreAudio.
